Switchboard Repairs & Upgrades Perth FAQs

Prepare the request and approval

Give the property location, observable symptoms or intended installation, access contact and the person who can approve the work. The agreed quote sets out the assessment and work; submitting a form does not reserve an appointment.

  • Perth electrical services
  • Fault finding before equipment replacement
  • Safety switch faults
  • RCD testing and findings
  • New outlet requirements
When does an older switchboard need repair or replacement?

Condition, faults, the existing protection and proposed electrical work guide that decision. An older board needs professional assessment, not an automatic full-replacement claim based on age alone.

Can I get an itemised quote before approving an upgrade?

Yes. The written scope identifies the proposed equipment and work, testing, any supply coordination and additional work requiring approval. Confirm inclusions before proceeding.

How much does a switchboard upgrade cost in Perth?

Cost depends on the assessed installation, equipment, circuit work, access and supply arrangements. We quote for that scope; no single price is assumed to cover every board or property.

Will a switchboard upgrade fix a circuit that keeps tripping?

Not necessarily. The cause may lie in connected equipment or a circuit. Investigation should establish the fault before an upgrade is presented as the solution.
